answer: Dedicate your whole day to study because uninterrupted blocks of 12-16 hours maximize memory retention; try to study in one long session three or four nights in a row instead of weekly evening reviews; eliminating screen time and social media improves focus, even at intermediate stages; caffeine on an empty stomach can actually enhance concentration, so it’s okay to drink several cups upfront; multi-tasking by listening to music with lyrics or repeating tutorials while looking up notes keeps your learning actively engaged, so there’s little danger to cognitive load; if your mind starts drifting, it’s normal and not necessarily a problem unless you compel yourself to fix it for more than a few seconds every hour.
